calls.note: Opening the game. Casual phone gamer, want to see what this is fast.
Board is small. Guard is up top with a sleep z. Plan: walk under it and step up into it to borrow its key. Skimmed the instruction line, looks like the guard carries the key.
I am the guard now. Heading to the brown lock in the bottom row and then the exit. Guessing the key opens it.
Looks like the guard went straight through the brown gate. Exit is one step right. Just going.
calls.status: Out in 8 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Level 1 done in 8, par. Quick one. Next.

Level 2. Two bodies, a guard on the right and a blue cat down low, and a pink square in my path. Skimming the hint: cat can't see red so it walks through red stuff. I'll just push right and see what the pink one does.
The pink square stops me, spirit can't pass colour. So the cat has to be the way through. Stepping down into the cat.
I'm the cat now. Going right along the bottom row, then up into the guard for the key, same trick as level 1.
Hm, the cat ended up one row higher than I expected, it's sitting next to the pink square now and the square went dashed, so I can walk through. Pushing right into the guard.
Now I'm the guard with the key. Straight down through the brown gate and out the exit.
calls.status: Out in 10 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Level 2 out at par 10. Got it. Keep going, I'm bored of reading but the puzzles are quick.

Level 3. Looks like the cat is the one I need, it's up in the corner and the blue bridge is only for it. Black squares are pits. Plan: borrow the guard for the key to the brown gate, then hop up into the cat. Down then right into the guard.
Guard now. Walking right through the gate, then up into the sleeping cat.
I misjudged the grid by a column, the sleeping cat is actually one more step right of the guard. Bumping right into it.
Now the cat. Down, over to the dashed bridge column, down across it, then left onto the exit. Black squares are the pits I have to avoid.
Message says pit but I'm standing on the blue bridge in the cat, so I think I'm fine. Going down once more toward the exit row.
Cat is in the exit row now, exit is to the left.
calls.status: Out in 14 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Level 3 out at par 14. Mild annoyance: the pit message popped up even though I was on the bridge. Next.
Level 4 looks busier. Two guards, a cat down bottom, a lot of pink, and black pits. Exit is top middle behind a brown gate. Grabbing the nearest guard first to see what it can reach.
As the guard now. Going down the left column to see if the pink square blocks me like it did for the spirit.
Guard can walk the red square, it turned into a plain red tile for me. Going down two to bump the sleeping cat.
calls.status: the guard sees red: that block is solid

calls.note: Red is solid for the guard, my bad. The cat can walk red, so I need the cat. Looping the guard around the left side, through the brown gate it has the key for, then hopping into the cat from the side.
Now the cat. Up through the red square, across the bridge, over the red one on the right, then up into the sleeping guard there to borrow its key for the gate and the exit.
Guard again on the right side. Left through the gate, then up to the exit.
calls.status: Out in 17 turns (par!). Chapter complete: Eyes. Press N for Leftovers.

calls.note: Level 4 out at par 17. Chapter Eyes done. Next chapter is Leftovers.

Leftovers. The gate is a striped bar below the middle, and the exit is past it. Some body has to sit on the plate under me to hold the gate. Plan: become the cat, park it on the plate, then hop out into the guard so the cat stays put.
Cat is parked on the plate and the gate looks open now. Guard goes around and straight down through it to the exit.
calls.status: Out in 9 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Level 5 out, par 9. Feels like I'm just following the shape. Next.

Level 6. Pink squares are red so the cat walks them and the guard can't. Guard has the key for the brown gate near the exit. Get the guard, then hop into the cat so the cat can clear space, then hop back out to the guard.
Cat, step down onto the pink, then left onto the other pink, then up into the guard I left behind.
Guard again. Going right across the top of the cat's old spot, down through the gate and out.
calls.status: Out in 13 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Level 6 out at par 13. The puzzle was clear enough once I stopped reading and just looked at where the bodies were. Next.

Level 7. The plate is under the square with a dot, the gate is striped right under the cat. Gate needs a body on the plate. The guard is far top left, so I'll go get the guard first, then park it on the plate and hop out into the cat.
Guard is mine. Walking it over to the plate.
Guard should be on the plate now, cat is right beside it. Hopping into the cat to walk out while the guard holds the gate.
Cat now, going straight down through the gate that the guard is holding open, across the grate and onto the exit.
calls.status: Out in 13 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Level 7 out at par 13. Used the guard to hold the plate. Fine. Moving on.

Level 8. Bucket brigade: it's a chain of bodies passing the plate job. Plate is the dotted square at the bottom. Gate is top right above the exit. Plan: hop cat up top, walk it down past the pink, into the guard, then get a cat onto the plate and hop around.
Cat walks right, then down across the pink, then bumps the guard below.
Guard now. Hopping left into the other cat, that one goes down onto the plate. Then I hop back up through the guard and into the first cat.
Cat on the plate is holding the gate open, the gate looks dashed now. I'm the top cat. Up, across, down through the gate, onto the exit.
calls.status: Out in 16 turns (par!). Chapter complete: Leftovers. Press N for Gates.
